'''Christopher Mason'''<ref name="dt-8492">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8492 A night at Dark Jedi Anonymous], DeckTech (Christopher "MaceW" Mason, 17 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8492/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8492/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018151429/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8492/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (also published as '''Chris Mason'''; DeckTech handle '''MaceW''') posted a [[Light]] [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]] list on DeckTech in July 2000. He played at [[January 2001 Columbus tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ columbus-ohio-1-13-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
